problem: Personal LinkedIn fallback source-level dedupe was active in production but absent from canonical Git and migration history, leaving replay/new environments vulnerable to reusing the same personal source.
root_cause: A production recovery modified powerhouse_prepare_daily_content_fallbacks_v1 directly while stale PR #2569 never reached main.
prevention: Fallback selection must exclude any content_id already used by an earlier linkedin_personal recommendation.
Production hotfixes must be reconciled into canonical Git with an idempotent migration.
Recovery migrations must no-op when the exact invariant is already present and fail closed on unknown function drift.

evidence.production_readback: fallback function contains prior content_id exclusion

failed_approaches: Leaving a direct production function patch outside canonical Git.
